title: Vaporesso Zero 2 Replacement 2ml pods - 2 Pack
description: The Vaporesso Zero 2 Replacement Pods are the perfect companion for the Vaporesso Zero 2 Pod Kit, blending sleek design with exceptional functionality. Each pod offers a 2ml e-liquid capacity and comes in three versatile options to suit different vaping styles. Choose the 1.0ohm Mesh Pod for a smooth, restricted Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) experience, the 1.3ohm CCELL Pod for stable and rich flavour, or the 0.3ohm CCELL Pod for a looser Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) draw. All pods feature Vaporesso’s innovative PTF (press-to-fill) filling system, ensuring quick, clean, and effortless refills without spills or mess. Designed for convenience and reliability, these replacement pods are ideal for vapers seeking a balance of simplicity, performance, and customisation in their vaping experience. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
